title: Same value, different types
prompt: Return true if a and b are equal as numbers, even if one arrived as text. same_value("5", 5) is true.
starter:
func same_value(a, b):
	return a == b
hints: Text "5" and number 5 are different types and never equal; convert first.

docs.name: int(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as a whole number; decimals are dropped, text like "42" is read.

solution:
func same_value(a, b):
	return int(a) == int(b)
